summary: OpenAI announces a faster 'fast mode' for the Sol model in its API (2.5x faster) and a 20% price cut for the Terra model.

mechanisms.reason: A stated 20% price cut on a named model is a concrete inference-economics claim.
mechanisms.quote: decreased the price of terra by 20%.

practices.reason: A stated 2.5x speedup in a new serving mode is a concrete latency gain engineers could switch on.
practices.quote: we also are releasing fast mode for sol in the API (2.5x faster!)

practices.reason: A stated 20% price reduction directly changes the cost calculus for using Terra in production.
practices.quote: decreased the price of terra by 20%.

notable_reason: Concrete, quantified price and speed changes to live API models are exactly the kind of stated economics an infrastructure investor tracks.
